The '''Forensics Unit''', also known as the '''Forensics Service''', was the criminal evidence unit operated by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].

==History==
The Forensics Unit was staffed by [[Scenes of Crimes Officer]]s and [[Forensics droid/Legends|Crime scene investigation droids]]. It also operated a morgue in the [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|CSF Headquarters]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the Forensics Unit responded to an explosion at [[Depot Bravo Five]].

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] forensics units responded to the the bombing of [[The Elite (hotel)|The Elite Hotel]] and the murder of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]].
